answer: Harbor Leasing doesn't allow third-party buyouts, so we can't buy your lease directly from them. You still have two options: buy the car out yourself first and then sell it to us, or return it at the end of your lease. If you buy it out first, you can then go through our normal selling process: get an offer, book an appraisal, have the car inspected, and sign the paperwork to get paid.
